patients.name: James Thompson
patients.dx: Type 2 diabetes, CKD stage 3, cellulitis L leg

tasks.name: Fetal heart rate check
tasks.why: Fetal monitoring every 4 hours is ordered at 30 weeks with high blood pressure.

meds.name: Carbidopa-levodopa
meds.freq: q4h while awake · crushed in applesauce

tc.why: Late Parkinson's doses can cause stiffness, falls and trouble swallowing within hours. Give within 30 minutes of the scheduled time.

tasks.name: Hemoglobin recheck (every 6 h)
tasks.why: Hemoglobin is 7.8 after an active bleed. A drop means he may need a transfusion.

tc.why: Sepsis was recognized at 08:25. Guidelines call for the first antibiotic within 1 hour, and each hour of delay raises the risk of death.
Part of the 1-hour sepsis antibiotic bundle (recognized 08:25).

tasks.name: Blood cultures x2 (before antibiotics)
tasks.why: Cultures must be drawn before the first antibiotic dose so the lab can identify the bacteria.

tasks.name: Repeat lactate
tasks.why: First lactate was 3.2 mmol/L. Guidelines call for a repeat when it is above 2.

alerts.title: Metformin contraindicated at current kidney function
alerts.why: Creatinine went up and estimated CrCl is now 29 mL/min. Metformin should not be used below 30. It can build up and cause lactic acidosis.
data: Rise of 1.5 mg/dL meets the acute kidney injury flag (≥ 0.3)
alerts.action: Hold metformin and ask the provider to change diabetes therapy.

alerts.title: Enoxaparin dose needs kidney adjustment
alerts.why: Estimated CrCl is 29 mL/min. For prevention doses below 30 mL/min, the usual dose is 30 mg daily, not 40 mg. Higher levels raise bleeding risk.
data: Rise of 1.5 mg/dL meets the acute kidney injury flag (≥ 0.3)
alerts.action: Ask the provider or pharmacist to adjust the dose before giving.

heldBack.title: Lisinopril and Spironolactone: potassium can rise
heldBack.why: Known combination. Potassium is 4.6, within range. Daily labs are ordered.

heldBack.title: Lisinopril + furosemide: additive BP lowering
heldBack.why: Common, intended combination. Vitals are monitored.

heldBack.title: Cefazolin with penicillin allergy
heldBack.why: Low cross-reactivity; tolerated previous doses without reaction.

heldBack.title: Diltiazem can raise atorvastatin levels
heldBack.why: Dose is within the usual limit. Monitor for muscle pain.

heldBack.title: Ondansetron: low QT risk at this dose
Enoxaparin: kidney function OK for current dose
Diphenhydramine in a patient over 65 (Beers list)
heldBack.why: May cause confusion or falls. Already a PRN with fall precautions.

heldBack.title: Prednisone can raise glucose
heldBack.why: Glucose is 148 mg/dL. Fingerstick checks are ordered.

heldBack.title: Doxycycline: pregnancy test negative on admission
heldBack.why: Take upright with a full glass of water.

heldBack.title: Labetalol + nifedipine: preferred in pregnancy
heldBack.why: Both are first-line for high blood pressure in pregnancy.

heldBack.title: Dysphagia: oral meds crushed per swallow evaluation
heldBack.why: Check each new oral order can be crushed.

heldBack.title: Ondansetron: low QT risk at this dose
NPO: all medications given IV
heldBack.why: NSAIDs, aspirin and anticoagulants will be blocked for this patient.

heldBack.title: Vancomycin: infuse over at least 90 minutes
heldBack.why: Est. CrCl 67 mL/min. Pharmacy will dose follow-up by levels.
